name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's motorsport journey began with a childhood obsession for the technical aspects of racing. He spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling go-karts, always striving for optimal performance. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. Before joining ProSport Racing, Klaus-Dieter honed his skills at a smaller racing outfit, where he meticulously managed testing schedules and provided invaluable feedback to the drivers. 

As a test driver coordinator, Klaus-Dieter is known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making. He believes in creating a structured and efficient testing environment, ensuring that every session yields actionable insights. He fosters open communication between the drivers, engineers, and mechanics, facilitating a collaborative approach to car development. His ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise recommendations makes him a valuable asset to the team, ensuring the cars are performing at their peak potential. Klaus-Dieter distinguishes himself with his near-encyclopedic knowledge of racing regulations and his ability to extract the maximum performance within those constraints.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a man of average height with a serious demeanor and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Insists on organizing the testing schedule with color-coded spreadsheets.
